transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hello — do you have any questions about your cataract surgery or recovery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I do have a few questions. First, I'm wondering when I can start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You can go back to light exercise after 1 week, and that includes gardening. I’d still avoid heavy work or lifting for a month. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I do. When can I start using my eye gel for dry eyes?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: If you were using eye drops before your operation, such as for dry eyes, it’s safe to continue using them unless you’ve been told otherwise. If you’re running low, your GP should be able to give you more. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: That's helpful, thank you. I'm also quite sensitive to bright light right now. Is that normal?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: A little sensitivity to light can be normal while your eyes adjust to the new lens. If it’s mild, wearing sunglasses outside is a good idea. But if the pain is severe, or your eye is red and painful as well, that’s not normal and may need to be checked. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: I see, wearing sunglasses makes sense. One last thing, should I still have some blurriness by now?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: It’s common for vision not to be completely clear in the first week after your operation. It should improve quickly over time. If it’s still blurry, or getting worse, we may need to check it. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No, that covers everything I needed to know. Thank you so much for your help!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Have all your questions been answered?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, all my questions have been answered. Thanks again!

verdict.label: pass

Finally, `escalation_criteria` was covered in turn 6: "But if the pain is severe, or your eye is red and painful as well, that’s not normal and may need to be checked."
